investigations.name: caspule-nfsim-multi-scale-coupling
investigations.title: CASPULE-NFSim Multiscale Coupling
investigations.description: Two studies probe the CASPULE + NFSim composite at different levels of spatial complexity: dimerization (simple pair formation) and polymer fractionation (size-selective harvesting of clusters up to 4 bonds per atom). Both use the same three-component wiring: CASPULE (MD) → ObservableDetector (spatial→non-spatial bridge) → NFSim (rule-based kinetics).
